summary: N2O is actually a colorless gas

comments.content:
Says wikipedia: "Nitrous oxide, commonly know as "laughing gas", is a
chemical compound with the chemical formula N2O. At room temperature, it is
a colorless non-flammable gas, with a pleasant, slightly sweet odor and taste."

This makes it easier to knock people out... should you want to.

I've found the strong effects of N2O support having it visible - that discourages
using it constantly (as opposed to CO2 which takes a longer time, but is invisible)
